items.stem: A band plans a tour of 5 cities and must return home. The travel distances (×100 km) are AB = 12; AC = 8; AD = 5; AE = 11; BC = 14; BD = 16; BE = 7; CD = 12; CE = 17; DE = 13. (a) Use the nearest-neighbour algorithm starting at A to find an upper bound. (b) By deleting E, use the deleted-vertex algorithm to find a lower bound. (c) Write down an inequality for the length L of the optimal tour. (d) Explain why the nearest-neighbour algorithm may not give the optimal tour. (e) The optimal tour is in fact 47; comment on the quality of your bounds.
